title: Raw proper compact-support compositor and forget-supports comparison
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, p:W→X and f:X→S proper maps, and E an object of D(W_et,A). For the canonical composite p;f, the inverse of the specified compact-support composition isomorphism followed by the canonical proper comparison for p;f equals the ordinary composition path obtained by first comparing p, then comparing f, and finally applying the ordinary direct-image compositor.

source.place: First supported coordinate extraction before a trace; compactification compositor calculation after canonicalizing the composite

proof.text: Rewrite the canonical proper comparisons as the compactificationForgetSupports maps of the chosen compactifications. This is rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar_hom followed by rightDerivedLowerShriekToLowerStarComp_comp_eq.

Set d to the chosen compactification of f, and e to (chosen compactification of p;f).ofComp d. Expand the specified compositor into the comparison from d.comp e to the chosen compactification of p;f, the compatible-model compositor, and the inverse comparison for e.restrict. Use rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso_hom_app_comp_toLowerStar to remove the first comparison after forgetting supports.

Apply the compatible-model compositor equation to d and e. Combine the inverse comparison for e.restrict with its forget-supports map under the functor for d, using Functor.map_comp and the inverse form of the same refinement identity. The remaining expression is the required chosen-compactification route.

proof_origin.place: First triangle, chosen-compactification comparisons and common pullback counits.
proof_origin.why: The Lean proof completes both independence-of-compactification transports. Only the compatible-model exchange/open-composition calculation is left as a new substep.
